stem: What led Ann to consider using body heat as a way to power a flashlight?

options.label: F
options.text: She thought the idea was different enough to help her win the science fair.

options.label: G
options.text: She was asked to do so by a friend who was not able to study for school.

options.label: H
options.text: She wanted to make something that people without electricity could use.

options.label: J
options.text: She was determined to find a way to use a special material.
